thread:
Claire Ho: Quick follow-up from the 04:12UTC degradation. Root cause looks like repeated KV write stalls under ingestion bursts. We need a tracked remediation plan + SLO/SLA decision.

Ben Torres: Can you share the blast radius? which SLOs hit?

Claire Ho: p95 and p99 for /cache calls bumped. p95 140->320ms, p99 260->710ms over a 7min window. Throughput dipped briefly but recovered. Recurrence: 3 similar events in last 60d.

Marcus Li: Ops options: throttle bursts (feeder) OR temporary SLO concession. Ops prefers concession + quiet smoothed rollout.

emily.ops: I can apply a temporary p99 concession to 400ms for 72h and note it in the SLA log. Auto-revert enabled.

Claire Ho: Draft action list: 1) Apply temp SLO p99->400ms for 72h (owner emily.ops, immediate) 2) Feeder smoothing PR reduce burst cap 2000->1000 (owner Ben, 24h) 3) KV-driver fsync coalescer (owner Marcus, 5d) 4) Observability: add p99-by-prefix heatmap + 1m probe (owner Claire, 48h) 5) Recurrence-watch: open INF-4900 to auto-trigger mitigation if >=2 events/30d (owner Claire, 7d).

slo-bot: Recommended change message: "temp: p99 SLO to 400ms for 72h - INF-4900"

Ben Torres: I'll open PR with canary rollout and perf artifacts. ETA ~20h. Will include probe in the PR.

Marcus Li: I'll start on driver toggles. Prototyping fsync coalescer; ETA 4d. Will open INF-4901.

emily.ops: Applied SLO tweak and posted note in #announcements. Set auto-revert and linked INF-4900. Billing impact: none.

Claire Ho: Observability query suggestion (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(cache_request_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, prefix))
```
Alert: warn at 350ms(5m), page at 400ms(10m).

Ben Torres: PR created: https://git.redwood/feeder/pull/1001. Canary steps and perf attached.

Marcus Li: INF-4901 opened for driver changes. Will post repro and patch plan in PR.

recurrence-bot: Created INF-4900 "recurrence-watch: kv-write-stalls" and linked thread.

Claire Ho: Recap owners: emily.ops (SLO), Ben (feeder PR), Marcus (driver), Claire (observability + recurrence). 15m sync tomorrow to confirm PRs/tickets linked. Closing when all PRs referenced.

Ben Torres: :thumbsup:

Marcus Li: On it.
